hero.title: The Legend of Vox Machina — S4 Final Drop (Eps 10–12)
hero.format: Full S4 binge available 6/24 (12 eps, three-episode weekly rollout completes this Wednesday)
hero.about: A year after the Chroma Conclave, Vox Machina has scattered, chasing love, family, and purpose — until a long-slumbering evil reunites them for one more campaign. The final three episodes drop Wednesday 6/24, completing the full season.
hero.why: Sits squarely in your Rick and Morty / Solar Opposites / Foundation lane: adult animated fantasy, ensemble, witty banter, real world-building, ~30-min episodes — every signal that lands for you. The full season is binge-ready as of 6/24, so it's the right call instead of pacing weekly.

new_this_week.why: Listed for completeness — high-profile Netflix drop this week — but documentary/political reflection isn't in your loved lane. Skip unless you specifically want something contemplative.
